Moero!! Pro Yakyuu Rookies.name: Moero!! Pro Yakyuu Rookies
Moero!! Pro Yakyuu Rookies.summary: Moero!! Pro Yakyuu Rookies is a Sports game, developed by TOSE and published by Jaleco Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2000.

Tekken Card Challenge.name: Tekken Card Challenge
Tekken Card Challenge.summary: Tekken Card Challenge is a turn-based fighting game released only in Japan for the WonderSwan. It uses the characters from Tekken 3 plus an exclusive character to the game named Crow.
